items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I was married to Dudley then... That was my first husband... Dudley was a clarinet player. Yes. And he had a band. It was Dudley with my husband.

ctx.x: Was that near Beale Street or down in that part? Right on it. Right down there, yes.

He worked over there at the White Park, and he worked over here at the Cove Park. And my house, I was married to Dudley then. I know you've heard of Dudley. Yes, I've heard. I had theatre and... Yes, I've heard the name. Well, that was my first husband. That was your first husband. Yes, and we were brought that theatre there, opened that theatre, bought that theatre. And that's where we separated. And, uh, Klein, the fellow that used to book the shows, whatever, used to book that whole section, he used to come…
When was the first time you met him, or when did you start working with him?
